clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: This policy governs indicative eligibility for fixed-rate loans on new private passenger vehicles in India, denominated in INR. It is a synthetic document created for a capstone demonstration and is not an offer of credit.

clauses.title: Credit score
clauses.text: Applicants must have a credit score of at least 650 from an accepted bureau. Accepted bureaus are CIBIL and EXPERIAN.

clauses.title: Minimum income
clauses.text: Qualifying monthly income must be at least INR 25,000. Annual income is converted to a monthly figure by dividing by 12.

clauses.title: Employment
clauses.text: Eligible employment categories are salaried and self-employed. Salaried applicants require at least 6 months of continuous employment. Self-employed applicants require at least 24 months in business.

clauses.title: Debt-service limit
clauses.text: Total monthly debt obligations, including the proposed EMI, must not exceed 50% of qualifying monthly income. The maximum loan is the principal that the remaining monthly capacity can repay over the chosen tenure.

clauses.title: Interest rates
clauses.text: Interest is charged at a fixed nominal annual rate compounded monthly, determined by credit score: 750 to 900 at 8.75%; 700 to 749 at 9.75%; 650 to 699 at 11.25%.

clauses.title: Tenure
clauses.text: Loan tenure must be between 12 and 84 monthly instalments.

clauses.title: Loan amount
clauses.text: The loan principal must be between INR 1,00,000 and INR 50,00,000.

clauses.title: Loan-to-value
clauses.text: The loan may not exceed 85% of the vehicle on-road price, being the ex-showroom price plus registration, insurance and other mandatory charges.

clauses.title: Processing fee
clauses.text: A processing fee of 1% of the loan principal, subject to a minimum of INR 2,500 and a maximum of INR 15,000, is payable upfront and is not financed.

clauses.title: Vehicle restrictions
clauses.text: Commercial vehicles are excluded. Vehicle prices older than 120 days must be re-verified before affordability is confirmed.

clauses.title: Rounding
clauses.text: EMIs are rounded half-up to the nearest 0.01 rupee. The eligible principal is rounded down to the nearest INR 1,000.
